description: This shell script module provides functions and configurations for setting up and managing IPv4-in-IPv6 tunneling protocols, specifically for IPIP6 and DS-Lite. It includes setup, teardown, and initialization functions, handling IP address resolution, tunnel configuration, and network routing.

methods.name: tnl_setup
methods.description: Sets up a tunnel configuration with specified parameters, including IP addresses, tunnel type, and related network settings.

methods.name: proto_ipip6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration specific to IPIP6 tunnels.

methods.name: proto_ipip6_setup
methods.description: Sets up an IPIP6 tunnel using provided configuration.

methods.name: proto_dslite_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration specific to DS-Lite tunnels.

methods.name: proto_dslite_setup
methods.description: Sets up a DS-Lite tunnel with default IP addresses.
